Source Wedding celebrations are reportedly on the cards in the Mega family, with actor Sai Durgha Tej all set to take a significant step in his personal life. According to industry reports, the actor’s engagement ceremony is scheduled for November 5 in the presence of close family members. 
 The engagement is expected to be an intimate yet special occasion, bringing together members of the Mega family. Reports further suggest that the actor’s wedding has been fixed for December and is likely to take place in Hyderabad. 
 Sai Durgha Tej’s reported wedding plans have already sparked curiosity among fans, who are keen to know more about his bride-to-be and the upcoming celebrations. 
 Interestingly, the Mega family has another reason to celebrate, as Varun Tej and Lavanya Tripathi recently marked their first wedding anniversary. With Sai Durgha Tej reportedly preparing to tie the knot next, wedding festivities seem to be continuing in the Mega household.
